beranda.description: A web application for reading the Quran easily and comfortably.
beranda.detail_1: Access all 114 chapters with beautiful Arabic text and translations.
beranda.detail_2: Never miss a prayer with accurate prayer times based on your location.
beranda.detail_3: Save your favorite verses and access them anytime.

footer.description: Thank you for using Quran's Web. We hope this application helps you in your Quran reading journey.
